name: 33430 · Belle Glade, FL
findings: ZIP 33430 (Belle Glade) has 46 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33430 (Belle Glade) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
67% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
